scripts.dev: export NODE_ENV=development && pnpm run build && pnpm run start
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -w run typecheck:libs && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.test: if [ -z "$LEDGERFLOW_TEST_DATABASE_URL" ]; then echo "LEDGERFLOW_TEST_DATABASE_URL must point to an isolated test database." >&2; exit 1; fi; DATABASE_URL="$LEDGERFLOW_TEST_DATABASE_URL" tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 test/**/*.test.ts
scripts.test:ci: TEST_DATABASE_URL="$(tsx ./test/prepare-ci-database.ts)" && DATABASE_URL="$TEST_DATABASE_URL" pnpm --filter @workspace/db run push && LEDGERFLOW_TEST_DATABASE_URL="$TEST_DATABASE_URL" pnpm run test
